trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet the user and confirm they are the patient.
steps.text: Hello, मैं City Hospital admission desk से बात कर रही हूँ। क्या मेरी बात patient ID PT-2009 से हो रही है?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and express time pressure.
steps.text: हाँ, बोल रहा हूँ। थोड़ा हल्दी बताइए, I have a meeting in five minutes.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge time pressure and ask for verification factor.
steps.text: Sure sir, मैं जल्दी wrap up करूँगी। Verification के लिए, please अपना date of birth confirm करेंगे?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided date of birth.
Return verification success.
Inform the user that the decision is available and prepare to check details.
steps.text: Thank you. आपका policy POL-55509 का Gallbladder removal के लिए pre-authorisation decision आ गया है। मैं exact details check कर लेती हूँ।

steps.purpose: Look up policy coverage to see the approved balance.
Return malformed data to test agent's robustness.
Handle the unusable tool response without making up facts.
steps.text: Sir, system में details load होने में error आ रहा है। एक second और दीजिए please.

steps.purpose: Express impatience.
steps.text: अरे यार, जल्दी कीजिए। अगर partial approval है तो बस amount बता दीजिए मुझे।

steps.purpose: Retry looking up policy coverage.
Return complete policy coverage data.
Get the procedure cost to explain the partial approval.
Return the package estimate.
Explain the approved amount based on the balance.
steps.text: Sir, आपके StarHealth policy में सिर्फ 120000 का balance बचा था, तो उन्होंने वही amount approve किया है।

steps.purpose: Ask for the total cost and the difference to pay.
steps.text: Okay, तो total cost कितना था surgery का? मुझे difference बताइए।

steps.purpose: State the package estimate and the calculated difference.
steps.text: Gallbladder removal का total package estimate 150000 है। इसलिए आपको बाकी के 30000 अपनी तरफ से pay करने होंगे।

steps.purpose: Ask for the room category.
steps.text: और room category कौनसी मिलेगी इसमें?

steps.purpose: Clarify the room category and rent.
steps.text: यह estimate general room के हिसाब से है, जिसका rent 3000 per day है।

steps.purpose: Accept the information and end the call.
steps.text: ठीक है, मैं admission के time देखता हूँ। I need to drop now.

steps.purpose: Close the call politely.
steps.text: No problem sir. Thank you और अपना ख्याल रखिए।

ir.terminal_condition: Patient told why full cashless is unavailable and what the alternative is.

variant_findings.reason: The tool returns an ERROR_TIMEOUT with zeroed values. The agent correctly handles it by informing the user of a loading error and retrying, without inventing any missing data.
variant_findings.label: Error Resolution > Action Failure Recovery > Invalid Tool Response

variant_findings.reason: The agent hallucinates that a pre-authorisation decision has already arrived and that the insurer approved the balance amount. No tool result provided an approval status, directly violating the grounding requirement.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent hallucinates that a pre-authorisation decision has arrived and that the insurer approved 120,000 (e7, e16). The tools only show the policy balance, not an approval status, violating Tool Output Grounding. Additionally, the agent guesses the 'general' room category for the estimate (e14) without asking the user, and never calls `submit_preauth_request` to actually submit the pre-authorisation.
issues.repair_instruction: Change the premise so the agent is calling to process the pre-authorisation prior to admission, not to relay a decision. After identity verification, the agent should ask for the preferred room category before calling `estimate_procedure_cost`. Once the balance and estimate are retrieved, the agent must explain the 30,000 shortfall and ask if the patient wants to proceed. Upon agreement, the agent must call `submit_preauth_request` and provide the resulting preauth_id and decision window to the user.

issues.detail: The user's utterance in e2 contains a typo 'हल्दी' (turmeric) instead of 'जल्दी' (quickly). Since `corrupted` is false and `clean_text` matches `model_visible_text`, this is a script typo rather than a properly configured STT error.
issues.repair_instruction: Correct the clean_text in e2 to 'जल्दी' and use the speech object fields to properly simulate the STT error 'हल्दी' in model_visible_text with corrupted set to true, or simply correct the typo to 'जल्दी' if no STT error was intended.

verification.summary: The conversation fails primarily because the agent hallucinates an approval status that was never returned by any tool, violating the Tool Output Grounding variant. The agent also guesses a tool argument without user input, fails to submit the actual pre-authorisation request to meet the terminal success condition, and contains a script typo instead of a valid STT error.
